care.summary: Stunning philodendron with dark green leaves boldly striped in creamy white; a compact grower with unique variegation.
care.light: Bright indirect light; avoid direct sun which burns leaves
care.water: Water when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry; reduce in winter
care.soil: Well-draining, airy potting mix with orchid bark and perlite
care.humidity: Moderate to high (50-70%); benefits from humidifier or pebble tray
care.fertilizer: Balanced fertilizer diluted to half strength monthly in spring and summer
common_issues: Reverting to all-green if light is too low
Brown leaf edges from low humidity
tips: Keep in consistent humidity to prevent leaf browning
Does not need a moss pole as it stays compact
Clean leaves gently with damp cloth
Propagate by stem cuttings in water or sphagnum moss
